# PortdayGuide

> Independent cruise-port planning guides focused on terminal choice, realistic transfer time, return-to-ship margins, and relevant shore excursions.

Canonical site: https://portdayguide.com/
Language: English (United States)

## Main sections

- Cruise port guide directory: https://portdayguide.com/ports
- Free cruise port-day planner: https://portdayguide.com/planner
- Cruise planning blog: https://portdayguide.com/blog
- Alaska cruise ports pillar guide: https://portdayguide.com/blog/alaska-cruise-ports
- Cruise terminal pillar guide: https://portdayguide.com/blog/future-of-cruise-ship-terminals
- MCO to Port Canaveral transportation guide: https://portdayguide.com/blog/future-of-cruise-ship-terminals/mco-to-port-canaveral/

- Affiliate disclosure: https://portdayguide.com/disclosure

## Content model

- Port hubs explain possible berths, transfer assumptions, top activities, 6- and 8-hour planning structures, practical tips, FAQs, and related ports.
- Focused decision guides compare terminals, transport options, beach access, taxi planning, tender operations, and return timing for selected ports.
- Blog articles cover Alaska cruise ports and routes, cruise-terminal trends, passenger technology, sustainability, airport-to-port transportation, and the wider context behind port-day planning.
- Live Viator fields may include product title, price, pricing unit, rating, review count, duration, availability, and cancellation information. These fields can change independently of editorial copy.

## Important limitations

PortdayGuide is a planning aid, not a cruise line, travel agency, tour operator, transport provider, or safety guarantee. Cruise-line documents and same-day operational instructions control. Readers should verify berth, all-aboard time, meeting point, accessibility, weather, price, cancellation terms, and return transport before acting.

## Attribution and reuse

PortdayGuide text is published for reader use on the website. Third-party photographs, maps, product data, trademarks, and linked sources retain their own licenses and terms. Follow the source and license links shown on each page before reusing third-party material.
